description: Change a widget. Only the fields sent are changed, with one exception: sending ANY of questions, quizQuestions, quizTiers or calcInputs replaces ALL FOUR with exactly what is sent, so send the complete set you want to end up with. Publishing is a separate action. Views and completions cannot be set — they are counted from real traffic. The result lists `issues` — what is still missing before it could go live. What each kind needs (send only name and kind and the rest starts from sensible defaults): lead-magnet — headline, description, buttonText, contentUrl (a link to the file), optional questions; type "ai" personalises the delivery and needs at least one question. popup — headline, description, buttonText, plus trigger (immediate | exit-intent | scroll | time) with triggerValue (seconds for time, percent for scroll) and placement (center | bottom-right | bottom-left | top-right | top-left); a popup defaults to a time trigger of 8 seconds. For more than one condition, or a click/hover trigger, send triggers (an array of {type: immediate | exit-intent | scroll | time | click | hover, value, selector}; selector is a CSS selector on the host page, only meaningful for click/hover) with triggerMode "any" (the default — opens on the first one met) or "all" (waits for every one). startAt/endAt (epoch milliseconds) bound when a widget runs at all; leave both unset to run with no date limit. survey — questions, each {text, type: short | long | single | multi, options: [] (labels, only for single and multi)}; asks for an email afterwards only if requireEmail is true. quiz — quizQuestions [{text, options: [{label, score}]}] with at least two options each, and quizTiers [{minScore, maxScore, label, message}]; the visitor's total is the sum of the chosen options' scores, and the tiers must cover every possible total from the lowest to the highest with no gap. calculator — calcInputs [{label, min, max, step, default}] (integers), calcFormula using the inputs BY POSITION as a, b, c… with + - * / and brackets (e.g. "a * b * 12"), and calcOutputTemplate where {{result}} is replaced by the answer (e.g. "You could save ${{result}} a year"). announcement-bar — barMessage, barCtaText (the link label), barCtaUrl, barPosition (top | bottom). Popups and bars load sitewide from the one install snippet and can be kept off pages: hideOnValue lists URL pieces they never show on (e.g. "/checkout, /thank-you"), and showOn "url" with showOnValue limits them to pages whose URL contains one of the pieces; showOn "all" is every page. Style is optional and inherits the account's brand when omitted: theme, accentColor, backgroundColor, textColor (hex), cornerStyle, logoUrl.
